hooks.command: msa_hook_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && msa_hook_output=$(node "$msa_hook_root/.agents/hooks/collab-guard.mjs" codex); msa_hook_exit=$?; if [ "$msa_hook_exit" -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s' "$msa_hook_output"; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Workspace guard could not start or failed. Stop writes and repair the hook."}}'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: try { $msaHookRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Git root unavailable" }; $msaHookOutput = & node "$msaHookRoot/.agents/hooks/collab-guard.mjs" codex; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Guard failed" }; [Console]::Out.Write(($msaHookOutput -join "`n")) } catch { [Console]::Out.Write('{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Workspace guard could not start or failed. Stop writes and repair the hook."}}') }
